title: The Aztec Empire
text: The Aztec Empire, also known as the Triple Alliance, was a large Mesoamerican empire that flourished from 1428 to 1521 CE. It was centered in the Valley of Mexico, with its capital at Tenochtitlan (modern Mexico City). At its height, the empire controlled approximately 200,000 square kilometers and a population of 5–6 million. The Aztecs developed advanced agriculture (chinampas — floating gardens), sophisticated calendar systems, and monumental architecture. Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés, allied with indigenous groups opposed to Aztec rule, conquered Tenochtitlan in 1521, ending the empire. Aztec religion involved polytheism and ritual human sacrifice to honor gods including Huitzilopochtli (sun god) and Quetzalcoatl.
